verses.kjv: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels' necks.
verses.modern: the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was 1,700 shekels of gold, besides the crescent ornaments and the pendants and the purple garments worn by the kings of Midian, and besides the collars that were around the necks of their camels.

verses.kjv: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
verses.modern: Gideon made an ephod of it and put it in his city, in Ophrah. And all Israel whored after it there. It became a snare to Gideon and to his family.

verses.kjv: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
verses.modern: So Midian was subdued before the people of Israel. They raised their heads no more. And the land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.

verses.kjv: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
verses.modern: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.

verses.kjv: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.
verses.modern: Now Gideon had seventy sons, his own seed, for he had many wives.

verses.kjv: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
verses.modern: his concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son. He called his name Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.modern: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, at Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.
verses.modern: As soon as Gideon died, the people of Israel turned again and whored after the Baals and made Baal-berith their god.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
verses.modern: the people of Israel did not remember the LORD their God, Who had delivered them from the hand of all their enemies on every side,

verses.kjv: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.
verses.modern: they did not show mercy to the family of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) in return for all the good that he had done to Israel.

chapters.summary: Gideon pursued and captured the Midianite kings Zebah and Zalmunna east of the Jordan. He refused the people's offer to make him king but made a golden ephod that became a snare to Israel; after his death, the people returned to Baal worship.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
verses.modern: Now Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother's brothers and said to them and to the whole clan of his mother's family,

verses.kjv: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
verses.modern: "Say in the ears of all the leaders of Shechem, 'Which is better for you, that all seventy of the sons of Jerubbaal rule over you, or that one rule over you?' Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh."

verses.kjv: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
verses.modern: his mother's brothers spoke all these words on his behalf in the ears of all the leaders of Shechem. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, "He is our brother."

verses.kjv: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
verses.modern: they gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith with which Abimelech hired worthless and reckless fellows, who followed him.

verses.kjv: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
verses.modern: he went to his father's house at Ophrah and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, seventy men, on one stone. But Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

verses.kjv: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.modern: all the leaders of Shechem and all the house of Millo came together. They went and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar at Shechem.

verses.kjv: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
verses.modern: When it was told to Jotham, he went and stood on top of Mount Gerizim and cried aloud and said to them, "Listen to me, you leaders of Shechem, that God may listen to you.

verses.kjv: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
verses.modern: The trees once went out to anoint a king over them. They said to the olive tree, 'Reign over us.'

verses.kjv: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.modern: But the olive tree said to them, 'Shall I leave my abundance, by which gods and men are honored, and go hold sway over the trees?'

verses.kjv: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.modern: the trees said to the fig tree, 'You come and reign over us.'

verses.kjv: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.modern: But the fig tree said to them, 'Shall I leave my sweetness and my good fruit and go hold sway over the trees?'

verses.kjv: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.modern: the trees said to the vine, 'You come and reign over us.'

verses.kjv: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.modern: But the vine said to them, 'Shall I leave my wine that cheers God and men and go hold sway over the trees?'

verses.kjv: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
verses.modern: Then all the trees said to the bramble, 'You come and reign over us.'

verses.kjv: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.modern: the bramble said to the trees, 'If in good faith you are anointing me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade, but if not, let fire come out of the bramble and devour the cedars of Lebanon.'

verses.kjv: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
verses.modern: Now therefore, if you acted in good faith and integrity when you made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house and have done to him as his deeds deserved—

verses.kjv: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
verses.modern: for my father fought for you and risked his life and delivered you from the hand of Midian,

verses.kjv: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
verses.modern: you have risen up against my father's house this day and have killed his sons, seventy men on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the leaders of Shechem, because he is your relative—

verses.kjv: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
verses.modern: if you then have acted in good faith and integrity with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you.

verses.kjv: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
verses.modern: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the leaders of Shechem and the house of Millo. Let fire come out from the leaders of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech."

verses.kjv: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.modern: Then Jotham ran away and fled and went to Beer and lived there, because of Abimelech his brother.

verses.kjv: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
verses.modern: Abimelech ruled over Israel three years.

verses.kjv: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
verses.modern: God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem, and the leaders of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

verses.kjv: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
verses.modern: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come. Their blood be laid on Abimelech their brother, who killed them, and on the men of Shechem, who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.

verses.kjv: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
verses.modern: the leaders of Shechem put men in ambush against him on the mountaintops. They robbed all who passed by them along that way. And it was told to Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
verses.modern: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and moved to Shechem, and the leaders of Shechem put their confidence in him.

verses.kjv: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.modern: They went out into the fields, gathered the grapes from their vineyards, trod them, and held a festival. They went into the house of their god, ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
verses.modern: Gaal the son of Ebed said, "Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Is he not the son of Jerubbaal, and is not Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem. Why should we serve him?

verses.kjv: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
verses.modern: If only this people were under my command, then I would remove Abimelech." He said to Abimelech, "Increase your army and come out."

verses.kjv: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.modern: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.

verses.kjv: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
verses.modern: He sent messengers secretly to Abimelech, saying, "Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem, and they are stirring up the city against you.

verses.kjv: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
verses.modern: Now therefore go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
verses.modern: In the morning, as soon as the sun is up, rise early and rush upon the city. And when he and the people who are with him come out against you, you may do to them as your hand finds opportunity."

verses.kjv: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.modern: Abimelech and all the people who were with him rose by night and set an ambush against Shechem in four companies.

verses.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.
verses.modern: Gaal the son of Ebed went out and stood at the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech and the people who were with him rose up from their ambush.

verses.kjv: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
verses.modern: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, "Look, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains." Zebul said to him, "You see the shadow of the mountains as if it were men."

verses.kjv: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
verses.modern: Gaal spoke again and said, "Look, people are coming down from the central highland, and one company is coming by the way of the oak of Meonenim."

verses.kjv: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
verses.modern: Then Zebul said to him, "Where is your mouth now, with which you said, 'Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?' Are these not the people whom you despised? Go out now and fight with them."

verses.kjv: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.modern: Gaal went out before the leaders of Shechem and fought with Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.modern: Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him. Many were wounded and fell, all the way to the entrance of the gate.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.modern: Abimelech lived at Arumah, and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, so that they could not live in Shechem.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
verses.modern: On the next day the people went out into the field, and it was told to Abimelech.

verses.kjv: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
verses.modern: He took his people and divided them into three companies and laid in wait in the field. He looked, and the people were coming out of the city. So he rose against them and struck them.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.
verses.modern: Abimelech and the company with him rushed forward and stood at the entrance of the gate of the city. The other two companies rushed against all who were in the field and killed them.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
verses.modern: Abimelech fought against the city all that day. He took the city, killed the people who were in it, broke down the city, and sowed it with salt.

verses.kjv: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
verses.modern: When all the leaders of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered the stronghold of the house of the god Berith.

verses.kjv: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.modern: It was told to Abimelech that all the leaders of the tower of Shechem had gathered together.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
verses.modern: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him. Abimelech took an axe in his hand, cut down a branch from the trees, lifted it, and laid it on his shoulder. He said to the people who were with him, "What you have seen me do, hurry and do as I have done."

verses.kjv: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.modern: All the people likewise cut down each his branch and followed Abimelech. They put the branches against the stronghold and set it on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also — about a thousand men and women.

verses.kjv: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.modern: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez and captured it.

verses.kjv: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
verses.modern: But there was a strong tower within the city. All the men and women and all the leaders of the city fled to it and shut themselves in. They went up to the roof of the tower.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.modern: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it and drew near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

verses.kjv: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
verses.modern: a certain woman threw an upper millstone on Abimelech's head and crushed his skull.

verses.kjv: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.modern: Then he called quickly to the young man his armor-bearer and said to him, "Draw your sword and kill me, lest they say of me, 'A woman killed him.' " And his young man thrust him through. He died.

verses.kjv: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
verses.modern: when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, everyone departed to his home.

verses.kjv: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
verses.modern: Thus God returned the evil of Abimelech, which He committed against His father in killing His seventy brothers.

verses.kjv: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.modern: God also made all the evil of the men of Shechem return on their heads, and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

chapters.summary: Abimelech, Gideon's son by a concubine, killed seventy of his brothers and was made king at Shechem; only Jotham escaped and pronounced a parable-curse. Shechem later turned against Abimelech, and he was killed when a woman dropped a millstone on his head at Thebez.

verses.kjv: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
verses.modern: After Abimelech there arose to save Israel Tola the son of Puah, son of Dodo, a man of Issachar. He lived at Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.modern: he judged Israel twenty-three years. Then He died and was buried at Shamir.

verses.kjv: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
verses.modern: After Him arose Jair the Gileadite, who judged Israel twenty-two years.

verses.kjv: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.modern: he had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys. They had thirty cities, called Havothjair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
verses.modern: Jair died and was buried in Kamon.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
verses.modern: The people of Israel again did what was evil in the sight of the LORD and served the Baals and the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites, and the gods of the Philistines. And they forsook the LORD and did not serve Him.

verses.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
verses.modern: So the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel. He sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the Ammonites,

verses.kjv: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.modern: they crushed and oppressed the people of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the people of Israel who were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

verses.kjv: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
verses.modern: the Ammonites crossed the Jordan to fight also against Judah and against Benjamin and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was severely distressed.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
verses.modern: the people of Israel cried out to the LORD, saying, "We have sinned against You, because we have forsaken our God and have served the Baals."

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.modern: the LORD said to the people of Israel, "Did I not save you from the Egyptians and from the Amorites, from the Ammonites and from the Philistines?

verses.kjv: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
verses.modern: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed You, and You cried out to me. I saved You out of their hand.

verses.kjv: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
verses.modern: Yet You have forsaken me and served other gods; therefore I will save You no more.

verses.kjv: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
verses.modern: Go and cry out to the gods whom You have chosen; let them save You in the time of Your distress."

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
verses.modern: the people of Israel said to the LORD, "We have sinned; do to us whatever seems good to You. Only please deliver us this day."

verses.kjv: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
verses.modern: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD. His soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

verses.kjv: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
verses.modern: Then the Ammonites were called to arms. They encamped in Gilead. And the people of Israel came together and encamped at Mizpah.

verses.kjv: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.modern: the people, the leaders of Gilead, said one to another, "Who is the man who will begin to fight against the Ammonites? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."

chapters.summary: Tola and Jair judged Israel for a combined forty-five years. Israel again served foreign gods and was oppressed by the Philistines and Ammonites for eighteen years; when they cried out, the LORD told them to call on the gods they had chosen, but relented when they put away their idols.

verses.kjv: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
verses.modern: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior. But He was the son of a prostitute. Gilead was the father of Jephthah.

verses.kjv: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.
verses.modern: Gilead's wife also bore Him sons. And when his wife's sons grew up, they drove Jephthah out and said to Him, "You shall not have an inheritance in our father's house, for You are the son of another woman."

verses.kjv: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
verses.modern: Then Jephthah fled from His brothers and lived in the land of Tob, and worthless fellows collected around Jephthah and went out with Him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
verses.modern: After a time the Ammonites made war against Israel.

verses.kjv: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
verses.modern: when the Ammonites made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to bring Jephthah from the land of Tob.

verses.kjv: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
verses.modern: they said to Jephthah, "Come and be our leader, that we may fight against the Ammonites."

verses.kjv: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
verses.modern: But Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "Did You not hate me and drive me out of my father's house? Why have You come to me now when You are in distress?"

verses.kjv: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.modern: the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "That is why we have turned to You now, that You may go with us and fight against the Ammonites and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead."

verses.kjv: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
verses.modern: Jephthah said to the elders of Gilead, "If You bring me home again to fight against the Ammonites, and the LORD gives them over to me, I will be Your head."

verses.kjv: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
verses.modern: the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, "The LORD will be witness between us, if we do not do as You say."

verses.kjv: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.
verses.modern: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and leader over them. And Jephthah spoke all His words before the LORD at Mizpah.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
verses.modern: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites, saying, "What do you have against me, that you have come to me to fight in my land?"

verses.kjv: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.
verses.modern: The king of the Ammonites answered the messengers of Jephthah, "Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon to the Jabbok and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore those lands again peaceably."

verses.kjv: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
verses.modern: Jephthah again sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites,

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
verses.modern: and said to him, "Thus says Jephthah: Israel did not take away the land of Moab or the land of the Ammonites.

verses.kjv: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
verses.modern: But when Israel came up from Egypt and walked through the wilderness to the Red sea and came to Kadesh,

verses.kjv: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
verses.modern: Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, 'Let me pass through your land.' But the king of Edom would not listen. In the same way they sent to the king of Moab, but he would not consent. So Israel stayed at Kadesh.

verses.kjv: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.modern: Then they journeyed through the wilderness and went around the land of Edom and the land of Moab. They came by the east side of the land of Moab and camped on the other side of the Arnon. They did not enter the territory of Moab, for the Arnon was the border of Moab.

verses.kjv: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
verses.modern: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, king of Heshbon. Israel said to him, 'Please let us pass through your land to our place.'

verses.kjv: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.modern: But Sihon did not trust Israel to pass through his territory. Instead, Sihon gathered all his people together, encamped at Jahaz, and fought with Israel.

verses.kjv: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.modern: The LORD God of Israel gave Sihon and all His people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel took possession of all the land of the Amorites who lived in that country.

verses.kjv: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
verses.modern: They took possession of all the territory of the Amorites from the Arnon to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness to the Jordan.

verses.kjv: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?
verses.modern: So now the LORD God of Israel has dispossessed the Amorites from before His people Israel — and should You possess it?

verses.kjv: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
verses.modern: Will You not possess what Chemosh Your god gives You to possess? So whatever the LORD our God has driven out from before us, that we will possess.

verses.kjv: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,
verses.modern: Are You any better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did He ever contend with Israel, or did He ever fight against them?

verses.kjv: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?
verses.modern: While Israel lived in Heshbon and its villages, in Aroer and its villages, and in all the cities along the banks of the Arnon — for three hundred years — why did You not recover them in that time?

verses.kjv: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
verses.modern: I therefore have not sinned against You, but You do me wrong by making war against me. May the LORD, the Judge, be judge this day between the people of Israel and the people of Ammon."

verses.kjv: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
verses.modern: But the king of the Ammonites did not listen to the words of Jephthah that he sent him.

verses.kjv: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
verses.modern: Then the Spirit of the LORD was upon Jephthah. He passed through Gilead and Manasseh and passed on to Mizpah of Gilead, and from Mizpah of Gilead He passed on to the Ammonites.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
verses.modern: Jephthah made a vow to the LORD and said, "If You will give the Ammonites into my hand,

verses.kjv: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD's, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
verses.modern: then whatever comes out from the doors of my house to meet me when I return in peace from the Ammonites shall be the LORD's. I will offer it up for a burnt offering."

verses.kjv: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.
verses.modern: So Jephthah crossed over to the Ammonites to fight against them. The LORD gave them into His hand.

verses.kjv: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
verses.modern: he struck them from Aroer to the neighborhood of Minnith, twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a great blow. So the Ammonites were subdued before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.modern: Then Jephthah came to His home at Mizpah. And His daughter came out to meet Him with tambourines and with dancing. She was His only child; besides her He had neither son nor daughter.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.
verses.modern: as soon as He saw her, He tore His clothes and said, "Alas, my daughter! You have brought me very low, and You have become the cause of great trouble to me. For I have opened my mouth to the LORD. I cannot take back my vow."

verses.kjv: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.
verses.modern: she said to Him, "My father, You have opened Your mouth to the LORD; do to me according to what has gone out of Your mouth, now that the LORD has avenged You on Your enemies, on the Ammonites."

verses.kjv: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
verses.modern: So she said to her father, "Let this thing be done for me: leave me alone two months, that I may go up and down on the mountains and weep for my virginity, I and my companions."

verses.kjv: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
verses.modern: he said, "Go." Then He sent her away for two months. She departed, she and her companions, and wept for her virginity on the mountains.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,
verses.modern: at the end of two months, she returned to her father, who did with her according to His vow that He had made. She had never known a man. And it became a custom in Israel

verses.kjv: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
verses.modern: that the daughters of Israel went year by year to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in the year.

chapters.summary: Jephthah the Gileadite, a mighty warrior and son of a prostitute, was recalled from exile to lead Israel against the Ammonites. He defeated the Ammonites in battle but was bound by a rash vow that cost him his daughter.

verses.kjv: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.
verses.modern: The men of Ephraim were called to arms. They went northward and said to Jephthah, "Why did you cross over to fight against the Ammonites and did not call us to go with you? We will burn your house over you with fire."

verses.kjv: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.
verses.modern: Jephthah said to them, "I and my people had a great dispute with the Ammonites, and when I called you, you did not save me from their hand.

verses.kjv: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?
verses.modern: when I saw that You would not save me, I took my life in my hand and crossed over against the Ammonites. The LORD gave them into my hand. Why then have You come up to me this day to fight against me?"

verses.kjv: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.
verses.modern: Then Jephthah gathered all the men of Gilead and fought with Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, "You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the midst of Ephraim and Manasseh."

verses.kjv: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
verses.modern: the Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. And when any of the fugitives of Ephraim said, "Let me go over," the men of Gilead said to him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" When he said, "No,"

verses.kjv: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
verses.modern: they said to him, "Then say Shibboleth," and he said, "Sibboleth," for he could not pronounce it right. Then they seized him and slaughtered him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time 42,000 of the Ephraimites fell.

verses.kjv: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
verses.modern: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died and was buried in his city in Gilead.

verses.kjv: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
verses.modern: After him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.

verses.kjv: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
verses.modern: He had thirty sons, and thirty daughters he gave in marriage outside his clan, and thirty daughters he brought in from outside for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

verses.kjv: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.
verses.modern: Then Ibzan died and was buried at Bethlehem.

verses.kjv: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
verses.modern: After him Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel. He judged Israel ten years.

verses.kjv: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
verses.modern: Then Elon the Zebulunite died and was buried at Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

verses.kjv: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
verses.modern: After him Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite judged Israel.

verses.kjv: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
verses.modern: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. He judged Israel eight years.

verses.kjv: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
verses.modern: Then Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died and was buried at Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.

chapters.summary: The men of Ephraim quarreled with Jephthah for not summoning them to fight, and a civil war broke out in which 42,000 Ephraimites were killed at the fords of the Jordan, identified by their inability to say "Shibboleth." Ibzan, Elon, and Abdon judged Israel after Jephthah.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
verses.modern: the people of Israel again did what was evil in the sight of the LORD, so the LORD gave them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years.

verses.kjv: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.
verses.modern: There was a certain man of Zorah, of the tribe of the Danites, whose name was Manoah. And his wife was barren and had no children.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
verses.modern: the angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her, " you are barren and have not borne children, but You shall conceive and bear a son.

verses.kjv: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:
verses.modern: Therefore be careful and drink no wine or strong drink, and eat nothing unclean,

verses.kjv: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.modern: for You shall conceive and bear a son. No razor shall come upon His head, for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel from the hand of the Philistines."

verses.kjv: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:
verses.modern: Then the woman came and told her husband, "A man of God came to me. His appearance was like the appearance of the angel of God, very awesome. I did not ask Him where He was from. He did not tell me His name.

verses.kjv: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.
verses.modern: But he said to me, ' you shall conceive and bear a son. So then drink no wine or strong drink, and eat nothing unclean, for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of His death.' "

verses.kjv: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
verses.modern: Then Manoah prayed to the LORD and said, "O Lord, please let the man of God whom You sent come again to us and teach us what we are to do with the child who will be born."

verses.kjv: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.
verses.modern: God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman as she sat in the field. But Manoah her husband was not with her.

verses.kjv: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.
verses.modern: So the woman ran quickly and told her husband, " the man who came to me the other day has appeared to me."

verses.kjv: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.
verses.modern: Manoah arose and went after his wife and came to the man and said to him, "Are you the man who spoke to this woman?" And he said, "I am."

verses.kjv: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?
verses.modern: Manoah said, "Now when your words come true, what is to be the child's manner of life, and what is his mission?"

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
verses.modern: the angel of the LORD said to Manoah, "Of all that I said to the woman let her be careful.

verses.kjv: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.
verses.modern: She may not eat of anything that comes from the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, or eat any unclean thing. All that I commanded her let her observe."

verses.kjv: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.
verses.modern: Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, "Please let us detain You and prepare a young goat for You."

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD.
verses.modern: the angel of the LORD said to Manoah, "If You detain me, I will not eat of Your food. But if You prepare a burnt offering, then offer it to the LORD." (For Manoah did not know that He was the angel of the LORD.)

verses.kjv: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?
verses.modern: Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, "What is Your name, so that, when Your words come true, we may honor You?"

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
verses.modern: the angel of the LORD said to Him, "Why do You ask my name, seeing it is wonderful?"

verses.kjv: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD: and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
verses.modern: So Manoah took the young goat with the grain offering, and offered it on the rock to the LORD, to the one who works wonders, and Manoah and his wife were watching.

verses.kjv: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.
verses.modern: when the flame went up toward heaven from the altar, the angel of the LORD went up in the flame of the altar. Now Manoah and his wife were watching. They fell on their faces to the ground.

verses.kjv: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.
verses.modern: The angel of the LORD appeared no more to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that He was the angel of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
verses.modern: Manoah said to his wife, "We shall surely die, for we have seen God."

verses.kjv: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.
verses.modern: But his wife said to Him, "If the LORD had meant to kill us, He would not have accepted a burnt offering and a grain offering at our hands, or shown us all these things, or now announced to us such things as these."

verses.kjv: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
verses.modern: the woman bore a son and called his name Samson. And the young man grew. The LORD blessed Him.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.modern: the Spirit of the LORD began to stir Him in the camp of Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

chapters.summary: Israel was given into the hand of the Philistines for forty years, and the angel of the LORD appeared to the wife of Manoah, announcing she would bear a Nazirite son. The child was born and named Samson, and the Spirit of the LORD began to stir him.

verses.kjv: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
verses.modern: Samson went down to Timnath, and at Timnath he saw one of the daughters of the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.
verses.modern: Then he came up and told his father and mother, "I saw one of the daughters of the Philistines at Timnath. Now get her for me as my wife."

verses.kjv: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
verses.modern: But his father and mother said to him, "Is there not a woman among the daughters of your relatives, or among all our people, that you must go to take a wife from the uncircumcised Philistines?" But Samson said to his father, "Get her for me, for she is right in my eyes."

verses.kjv: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
verses.modern: His father and mother did not know that it was from the LORD, for He was seeking an opportunity against the Philistines. At that time the Philistines ruled over Israel.

verses.kjv: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.
verses.modern: Then Samson went down with his father and mother to Timnath. They came to the vineyards of Timnath. And a young lion came toward him roaring.

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
verses.modern: Then the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon Him, and although He had nothing in His hand, He tore the lion in pieces as one tears a young goat. But He did not tell His father or His mother what He had done.

verses.kjv: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
verses.modern: Then he went down and talked with the woman. She was right in Samson's eyes.

verses.kjv: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
verses.modern: After some days he returned to take her. And he turned aside to see the carcass of the lion, and there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.

verses.kjv: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.
verses.modern: He scraped it out into his hands and went on, eating as he went. And he came to his father and mother and gave some to them. They ate. But he did not tell them that he had scraped the honey from the carcass of the lion.

verses.kjv: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.
verses.modern: His father went down to the woman, and Samson prepared a feast there, for so the young men used to do.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
verses.modern: As soon as the people saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

verses.kjv: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:
verses.modern: Samson said to them, "Let me now put a riddle to you. If you can tell me what it is within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes,

verses.kjv: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.
verses.modern: but if you cannot tell me what it is, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes." And they said to him, "Put your riddle, that we may hear it."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
verses.modern: he said to them, "Out of the eater came something to eat. Out of the strong came something sweet." And in three days they could not solve the riddle.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?
verses.modern: On the seventh day they said to Samson's wife, "Entice your husband to tell us what the riddle is, or we will burn you and your father's house with fire. Have you invited us here to impoverish us?"

verses.kjv: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?
verses.modern: Samson's wife wept over him and said, "You only hate me; you do not love me. You have put a riddle to my people, and you have not told me what it is." And he said to her, " I have not told my father nor my mother, and shall I tell you?"

verses.kjv: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
verses.modern: She wept before him the seven days that their feast lasted, and on the seventh day he told her, because she pressed him hard. Then she told the riddle to her people.

verses.kjv: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.
verses.modern: the men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, "What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?" And he said to them, "If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have found out my riddle."

verses.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.
verses.modern: the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon Him. He went down to Ashkelon and struck down thirty men of the town and took their spoil and gave the garments to those who had told the riddle. In hot anger He went back to His father's house.

verses.kjv: But Samson's wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.
verses.modern: Samson's wife was given to his companion, who had been his best man.

chapters.summary: Samson demanded a Philistine woman of Timnah as his wife, and on the way he killed a lion with his bare hands. At the wedding feast he posed a riddle; when his wife betrayed the answer, Samson struck down thirty men of Ashkelon to pay the wager.

verses.kjv: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.
verses.modern: After some days, at the time of wheat harvest, Samson went to visit his wife with a young goat. And he said, "I will go in to my wife in the chamber." But her father would not allow him to go in.

verses.kjv: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.
verses.modern: her father said, "I really thought that you utterly hated her, so I gave her to your companion. Is not her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please take her instead."

verses.kjv: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.
verses.modern: Samson said to them, "This time I shall be innocent in regard to the Philistines, when I do them harm."

verses.kjv: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.
verses.modern: So Samson went and caught 300 foxes and took torches. And he turned them tail to tail and put a torch between each pair of tails.

verses.kjv: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.
verses.modern: when he had set fire to the torches, he let the foxes go into the standing grain of the Philistines and set fire to the stacked grain and the standing grain, as well as the olive orchards.

verses.kjv: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.
verses.modern: Then the Philistines said, "Who has done this?" And they said, "Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he has taken his wife and given her to his companion." And the Philistines came up and burned her and her father with fire.

verses.kjv: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.
verses.modern: Samson said to them, "If this is what you do, I swear I will be avenged on you, and after that I will quit."

verses.kjv: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.
verses.modern: he struck them hip and thigh with a great blow. He went down and stayed in the cleft of the rock of Etam.

verses.kjv: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
verses.modern: Then the Philistines came up and encamped in Judah and made a raid on Lehi.

verses.kjv: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.
verses.modern: the men of Judah said, "Why have you come up against us?" They said, "We have come up to bind Samson, to do to him as he did to us."

verses.kjv: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.
verses.modern: Then 3,000 men of Judah went down to the cleft of the rock of Etam, and said to Samson, "Do you not know that the Philistines are rulers over us? What then is this that you have done to us?" And he said to them, "As they did to me, so have I done to them."

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.
verses.modern: they said to him, "We have come down to bind you, that we may give you into the hands of the Philistines." And Samson said to them, "Swear to me that you will not attack me yourselves."

verses.kjv: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.
verses.modern: They said to him, "No; we will only bind you and give you into their hands. We will surely not kill you." So they bound him with two new ropes and brought him up from the rock.

verses.kjv: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.
verses.modern: When He came to Lehi, the Philistines came shouting to meet Him. Then the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon Him, and the ropes that were on His arms became as flax that has caught fire. His bonds melted off His hands.

verses.kjv: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
verses.modern: he found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, and put out His hand and took it, and with it He struck 1,000 men.

verses.kjv: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.
verses.modern: Samson said, "With the jawbone of a donkey, heaps upon heaps, with the jawbone of a donkey have I struck down a thousand men."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.
verses.modern: As soon as he had finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone out of his hand. And that place was called Ramathlehi.

verses.kjv: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
verses.modern: he was very thirsty. He called upon the LORD and said, "You have granted this great salvation by the hand of Your servant, and shall I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?"

verses.kjv: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof Enhakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.
verses.modern: God split open the hollow place that is at Lehi, and water came out from it. And when He drank, His spirit returned. He revived. Therefore the name of it was called Enhakkore; it is at Lehi to this day.

verses.kjv: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
verses.modern: he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

chapters.summary: Samson burned the Philistines' grain fields with foxes and torches after his wife was given to another man. The Philistines retaliated, and Samson struck down a thousand men with the jawbone of a donkey at Lehi.

verses.kjv: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.
verses.modern: Samson went to Gaza, and there he saw a prostitute. He went in to her.

verses.kjv: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.
verses.modern: The Gazites were told, "Samson has come here." And they surrounded the place and set an ambush for him all night at the gate of the city. They kept quiet all night, saying, "Let us wait till the light of the morning; then we will kill him."

verses.kjv: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.
verses.modern: But Samson lay till midnight, and at midnight he arose and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city and the two posts, and pulled them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them to the top of the hill that is in front of Hebron.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
verses.modern: After this he loved a woman in the Valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

verses.kjv: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.
verses.modern: the lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, "Seduce him, and see where his great strength lies, and by what means we may overpower him, that we may bind him to humble him. And we will each give you 1,100 pieces of silver."

verses.kjv: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.
verses.modern: So Delilah said to Samson, "Please tell me where your great strength lies, and how you might be bound, that one could subdue you."

verses.kjv: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
verses.modern: Samson said to her, "If they bind me with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried, then I shall become weak and be like any other man."

verses.kjv: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
verses.modern: Then the lords of the Philistines brought her seven fresh bowstrings that had not been dried. She bound him with them.

verses.kjv: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.
verses.modern: Now she had men lying in ambush in an inner chamber. And she said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he snapped the bowstrings, as a thread of flax snaps when it touches the fire. So the secret of his strength was not known.

verses.kjv: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.
verses.modern: Then Delilah said to Samson, " you have mocked me and told me lies. Please tell me how you might be bound."

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
verses.modern: he said to her, "If they bind me with new ropes that have not been used, then I shall become weak and be like any other man."

verses.kjv: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.
verses.modern: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" And the men lying in ambush were in an inner chamber. But he snapped the ropes off his arms like a thread.

verses.kjv: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.
verses.modern: Then Delilah said to Samson, "Until now you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me how you might be bound." And he said to her, "If you weave the seven locks of my head with the web and fasten it tight with the pin, then I shall become weak and be like any other man."

verses.kjv: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.
verses.modern: So while he slept, Delilah took the seven locks of his head and wove them into the web. And she made them tight with the pin and said to him, "The Philistines are upon you, Samson!" But he awoke from his sleep and pulled away the pin, the loom, and the web.

verses.kjv: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth.
verses.modern: she said to him, "How can you say, 'I love you,' when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and you have not told me where your great strength lies."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;
verses.modern: when she pressed him hard with her words day after day, and urged him, his soul was vexed to death.

verses.kjv: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother's womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.
verses.modern: he told her all his heart, and said to her, "A razor has never come upon my head, for I have been a Nazarite to God from my mother's womb. If my head is shaved, then my strength will leave me. I shall become weak and be like any other man."

verses.kjv: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.
verses.modern: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called the lords of the Philistines, saying, "Come up again, for he has told me all his heart." Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hands.

verses.kjv: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
verses.modern: She made him sleep on her knees. And she called a man and had him shave off the seven locks of his head. Then she began to torment him. His strength left him.

verses.kjv: And she said, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the LORD was departed from him.
verses.modern: she said, "The Philistines are upon You, Samson!" And he awoke from his sleep and said, "I will go out as at other times and shake myself free." But He did not know that the LORD had left Him.

verses.kjv: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.
verses.modern: the Philistines seized Him and gouged out His eyes and brought Him down to Gaza and bound Him with bronze shackles. And He ground at the mill in the prison.

verses.kjv: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.
verses.modern: But the hair of His head began to grow again after it had been shaved.

verses.kjv: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.
verses.modern: Now the lords of the Philistines gathered to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god and to rejoice. They said, "Our god has given Samson our enemy into our hand."

verses.kjv: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.
verses.modern: when the people saw him, they praised their god. For they said, "Our god has given our enemy into our hand, the ravager of our country, who has killed many of us."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.
verses.modern: when their hearts were merry, they said, "Call Samson, that he may entertain us." So they called Samson out of the prison. He entertained them. They made him stand between the pillars.

verses.kjv: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.
verses.modern: Samson said to the young man who held him by the hand, "Let me feel the pillars on which the house rests, that I may lean against them."

verses.kjv: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.
verses.modern: Now the house was full of men and women. All the lords of the Philistines were there, and on the roof there were about 3,000 men and women, who looked on while Samson entertained.

verses.kjv: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
